editorial:
Imagine moving into a big house you just inherited, only to have your worst nightmare walk through the door on night one. You follow a mother and her two daughters who think they found a fresh start, but they actually walked into a trap set by some truly scary people. The vibe is heavy and tense, making you feel the panic as the mother tries to save her kids from a couple of killers who enjoy playing mind games. It starts off like a standard home invasion flick, but it quickly turns into something way more twisted and strange.

What really makes this work is the acting and the huge twist that flips everything you thought you knew on its head. The pacing starts slow but picks up speed once the chaos begins. If you like movies that mess with your head and leave you shocked, you will love this. It is definitely a bit mean-spirited, so be ready for some dark moments.
endingExplained: You find out that the adult scenes were all in the main daughter's head as a way to cope with her trauma. She never actually escaped the house; she was locked in a room for sixteen years. In the final scenes, she finally snaps out of her fantasy and fights back against her captors. She kills the killers and manages to escape the house for real, finally leaving her nightmare behind for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and movies with big plot twists.
